name: stira-kiro
description: Talk to your Kiro Crew agent in a pixel-art lab. The room shows what the agent is doing, long replies and diagrams drop onto a whiteboard, and the shelf opens your memory as books of chapters. UI in English and Japanese.
author: Resolver-TNG
highlights: Chat with a character in a pixel-art lab; long replies, diagrams and mcwidgets go to the whiteboard
The shelf is your memory index: environment notes, work journal, notes, projects and conversations, one book at a time
Conversations become chapters: situation, decisions, outcome, lessons (up to 10 a day; edit, rewrite or turn off)
Kiro draws on related chapters and knowledge leaves, on the Stage and in ordinary chats
A forest outside the window grows with your memory; other sessions' work appears as drones in the room
Each book gets an automatic narrative of where it stands; the optional kiro-pack attaches it to related messages in ordinary chats
useCases: Talk to Kiro in a good-looking chat screen while building up past decisions and experience as stories you can find again.
configuration: Enable the app and Stira Stage appears in the sidebar. Automatic chapters are switched on and off from the forest's control panel.
